articles.title: Bitcoin just broke below the floor of its famous Rainbow Chart into the ‘BTC is dead’ zone
articles.snippet: A 50% drop from recent highs has pushed the asset into a zone historically labeled as a dead end, sparking a debate among crypto analysts.

articles.title: Binance withdraws Greece-filed MiCA application
articles.snippet: Binance said it plans to seek authorization in another EU jurisdiction just days ahead of the July 1 MiCA deadline, as unlicensed crypto firms are expected to wind down activities in the bloc.

articles.title: US nears ban on CBDCs until 2030 as housing bill goes to Trump
articles.snippet: The House passed a housing bill with a central bank digital currency ban until 2030, meaning it now just needs US President Donald Trump’s sign-off.
